topography.project_purpose: Lending. Structurally: 83 project-authored contract(s) across 1 chain(s); 1 ERC4626 vault, 9 ERC20 tokens, 1 ERC1155 multi-token, 17 Chainlink feeds; role-gated via AccessControl; upgradeable via ERC1967/UUPS proxies; built on openzeppelin.
topography.relationship_narrative: The protocol comprises 3 functional families. Its contracts share 19 common project-authored base contract(s) (proxy, access, accessstorageutils). Dominant framework: openzeppelin.
